book.name: 2 Korintofɔ
book.title: Ɔwʋlʋ́ Nyɔɔsɩá Paulo Lɔ́wanlɩ́n Sɩ́sɩ́ Korintofɔ

content: Paulo Atowunhɛ Pʋ́ Mʋ Atɔ Lɛsúnáhɛ́
Ilehián ánɩ́ nótsu ɩwɩ, támɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɩma ɩwɩtsútɔ́. Támɛ mblɩ́ atɔ́á nowun pʋ́ tɔ́á anɩ Wíe lalɛ́ súná mɩ́.
Nfí dúana (14) nɩ́, bɔwan mɩ ya ɔsʋ́sʋ́ saasɩtɔ. (Mɩ́ nyankpʋsa-oyí lɔ́yɔ ɩnʋ o, mɩ́ ɔkláa o, mmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ bɩ́. Bulu nkʋlɛ yín.)
Fɛ́ alɩá nakʋ́blɩ́ á, bɔwan mɩ ya Paradiso. (Mɩ́ nyankpʋsa-oyí lɔ́yɔ ɩnʋ o, mɩ́ ɔkláa o, mmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ bɩ́. Bulu nkʋlɛ yín.) Nonu asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩma blɩ́tɔ́, ɔhaa ɛ́ má ɔkpa blɩ́ mʋ́.
Nɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́ ɩtɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ nowun amʋ tsú ɩwɩ, támɛ mmɔ́ɔpʋ mɩ́ atɔ bwɛhɛ́ tsú ɩwɩ. Ntobíá ɩtɛhá mɩ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ tɛba asɩ ntɔpʋ́tsú ɩwɩ.
Nɩ́ mbɛ́ɛ nótsu ɩwɩ kʋ́ráá á, mmóotsu ɩwɩ fɛ́ ɔha mimláhɛ, tsúfɛ́ nɛ́blɩ́ ɔnɔkwalɩ. Támɛ mmɔ́ɔbwɛ. Mmedékléá ɔhaa ɔkɩ́ɩ mɩ dafa alɩá mɩ́ tsiátɔ́ gyí, ntɛ́ɛ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ nɔpʋba amʋ.
Alɩá mmɔ́ɔpʋ ntobí ánfɩ ɩbʋ ifú, ɩbʋ wánwan, Bulu lalɛ́ súná mɩ́ ánfɩ tsú ɩwɩ sʋ á, ɔlɔpʋ owu kʋ wá mɩ́ awútɔ́, igyi Ɔbʋnsám-ɔbɔpʋ. Ɩtɛdá wɔ mɩ́, mɛ́nɩ mmóotsu ɩwɩ.
Nakókóli anɩ Wíe Yesu tse sa kɛ́kɛ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ɔlɛ́ ɩtɔ́ ámʋ mɩ́tɔ́.

Támɛ asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔtɛbláa mɩ brégyíbrɛ́ gyí, “Mɩ́ awɩtɔlɛ pɛ́ gyí tɔ́á fehián. Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ mʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ laba asɩtɔ mɩ́ túmi tɛhɩ́ɛ́ lɩn ɔwan.” Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɩbʋ mɩ ansigyí ánɩ́ nɔ́pʋ tɔ́á ɩtɛhá mɩ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ tɛba asɩ tsú ɩwɩ, mɛ́nɩ Kristo túmi ámʋ ɩbɛ́hɩɛ bun mɩsʋ.

Kristo sʋ ansɩ́ bégyi mɩ brégyíbrɛ́. Nɩ́ mɩ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ ɩba asɩ, bʋdɛ mɩ́ sia, mbʋ ɩkplántɔ, bʋdɩn mɩ́sʋ́, ntɛ́ɛ ɩwɩ dɛ mɩ́ ɔsɩn, tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ mɩ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ɔnɔ́ ɩba asɩ á, mʋ́ ntɛlányá ɔwʋnlɩ́n nɩ́.
Korinto Ɔpasua Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n
Nabwɛ́ ɩwɩ fɛ́ ɔha mimláhɛ, támɛ mlɩláhá ɩlaba alɩ. Tɛkɩ ilehián ánɩ́ mlɛ́blɩ́ asʋn wankláán tsú mɩ́ ɩwɩ. Tsúfɛ́ ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á mmegyí tɔtɔ, támɛ ndʋn “sumbí ayɔpʋ́ akpɔnkpɔntɩ” ánfɩ mʋ́.
Brɛ́á mbʋ mlɩ wá á, notomi bwɛ́ tɔ́á ɩbʋ wánwan pʋ́ osúna mʋ́a ofúla ɔtsan-ɔtsan, pʋ́súná mlɩ ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́ sumbí ɔyɔpʋ́ ngyi.
Ntɔ dɛ́ mlɩ háan? Tɔ́á nɔbwɛ mlɩtɔ, mmɔbwɛ ɔpasua bámbátɔ́ gyí, mmesi ɩwɩ tswɩ mlɩsʋ. Kókoli, mlɩsikie mɩ́!
Séi á, otse saasɩ ndɛbwɛá nɛ́ba mlɩ wá á. Mmɛ́ɛba besi ɩwɩ tswɩ mlɩsʋ, tsúfɛ́ mmɛdɛ́ tɔtɔ fɩtɛ́ tsú mlɩ wá. Mlɩ onutó ndehián. Kebi tamatsú mʋ sɩ wá akɔnkɔ, mʋ sɩ tótsú mʋ wá akɔnkɔ.
Ɩbʋ mɩ ɔdwɛá néyintá tógyítɔ́á mbʋ mlɩ sʋ, sí mɩ́ ɩwɩ fɛ́ɛ́ kʋ́ráá há mlɩ. Ɩ́nɩá ndɛ mlɩ dwɛ dʋbɩ alɩ á, ntogyi sʋ ɔdwɛá mlɩ mʋ́ mlɩbʋ há mɩ́sʋ́ dɛdɩnkɩ́?
Fíalɩ mlɩlawun ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́, mmɛba besi ɩwɩ tswɩ mlɩsʋ, támɛ mlɩdɛ́blɩ́ mlɩaa, nofwifwí ansɩ́. Ndɛpʋ atɔ́ tsʋn mlɩ omuá wá mlɩ ɔnɔ́.
Ɔkpa ɔmɔmʋsʋ? Nɔtsʋn ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ nɔwa mlɩ wá ámʋtɔ ɔkʋsʋ sísi mlɩ lóó?
Brɛ́á nokokóli Tito, nɔwa mʋa anɩ píó Okristoyin amʋ mlɩ wá mɛ́, olebesisíi mlɩ? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Tsúfɛ́ agywɩɩn kʋlɛ mɩ́a mʋnyɔ anɩdɛ́pʋbwɛ́ toku kʋlɛ.
Fíalɩ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ́ tsu brɛ́ ánfɩtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩaa, anɩdɛ́tɔɩ́ pʋ́ká ɩwɩ lɛ́. Megyí alɩ ígyi. Akristofɔ anɩgyí, anɩdɛ́tɔɩ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Mɩ́ adwɛpʋ́, anɩdɛ́ tógyítɔ́ bwɛ pʋ́wá mlɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n.
Tsúfɛ́ ifú dɛ mɩ́ ánɩ́ nɛ́ba mlɩmétsíe wankláán. Mʋ́ sʋ mɩ́ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ bɔ́wɔ mlɩ asʋtɔ. Fíalɩ nɔ́bɔtʋ ɩtrɛ́, ɔnsɩpɛ, ɔblɔ́, olu, ahásia, ahá ɩwɩ asʋ́nblɩ́, ɩwɩtsú pʋ́ abasʋda mlɩtɔ.

Nhɩ́ɛ́ ndɛ ifú nya ánɩ́ nɩ́ nɛbá ɩnʋ á, mɩ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́trá ba mɩ asɩ mlɩ sʋ. Nósu, tsúfɛ́ mlɩtɔ akʋ mlɩmɔ́kʋ́sí mlɩ lakpan dada amʋ bwɛ, dámlí klʋntɔ sí mbʋatɔ, hakpanla pʋ́ ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ amʋ.
